```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"DSA believes that an adequate response to the economic and environmental crisis requires the U.S. to adopt a radical reform program akin to DSA’s Economic Justice Agenda.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA emphasizes that only through strict democratic regulation of finance capital and raising the wages and working conditions for the global working class can the world economy serve people’s needs rather than people serving the needs of corporate elites.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"In the coming period, DSA will prioritize educating, agitating and organizing.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA will speak publicly about socialism.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Simplistic and misleading “anti-socialist” rhetoric is being used by the right to mobilize populist anger against any reforms that would modestly redistribute wealth, income, and opportunity in the United States.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA will hold well-publicized forums to educate the public.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA will produce timely literature to educate the public.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA will organize a visible presence at the 2010 U.S. Social Forum to educate the public.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA will represent DSA positions to the Socialist International to educate the public.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA will use newspapers, the Web, radio, video and public access TV to educate the public.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA will educate the public as to why Obama’s health-care and fiscal-stimulus plans are not socialist.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Obama’s health-care and fiscal-stimulus plans are similar to – if not weaker than – the policies of most other advanced capitalist democracies.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA will articulate why only forthrightly social democratic reforms, such as reinstituting progressive and corporate taxation and engaging in prudent, but massive defense cuts, could fund desperately needed public health care and investment in education, infrastructure and alternative energy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
